title: Create a promotion
text: A promotion is a deal the register applies automatically. The setup wizard has three steps.
steps: Click Sidebar > Promotions.
Click Add Promotion.
Choose Type. Pick the kind of deal. This cannot be changed later.
Details. Enter a name, set the discount, and choose the products or categories.
Schedule & Branches. Set when it runs and which branches use it.
Click Save.

title: Kinds of promotion
text: Each promotion type works for a different kind of deal. Product Discount is the simplest: it gives money off selected products.
steps: Happy Hour runs only during set hours. Limited-Time Sale runs between two dates.
Product Discount, Category Discount, Buy 1 Take 1, Buy X Get Y, and Free Gift depend on what is in the cart.
Birthday and First Purchase are tied to one customer, so the cashier must choose the customer first.
Promo Code waits until the cashier types the code.

title: Schedule a promotion
text: Set the date, day, and time together. The promotion only runs when all three match. Leave them empty and it runs all the time.
steps: Click Sidebar > Promotions, then Add Promotion or edit a deal.
Go to the Schedule & Branches step.
Set a start and end date for the sale period.
Choose the days of the week to limit when it runs, such as weekends only.
Set a time window for the sales hours. If the end time is before the start time, it runs overnight.
Click Save.

title: Turn promotions on at the register
text: Promotions only appear at the register when the branch has Enable Promotions turned on.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Cashier Settings.
Find Enable Promotions under Checkout Behavior and turn it on.
Click Save. Repeat this for each branch that should run deals.

title: Promotion is not applying
text: Check the deal, branch, schedule, and cashier setting in that order.
steps: Click Sidebar > Promotions. Is the Active switch on for the deal?
Is the branch selected in the Branches column?
Does the schedule include the current time?
Click Sidebar > Settings, then Cashier Settings. Is Enable Promotions turned on?
For Birthday and First Purchase, did the cashier choose the customer first?

title: Promo codes and printed coupons
text: A Promo Code deal only applies after the cashier types the code. You can also print a coupon and set a usage limit.
steps: Click Sidebar > Promotions, then Add Promotion.
Choose Promo Code and type the code, such as WELCOME50.
Design the coupon in the same step. Set the usage limit in the final step, then click Save.
To print it, click the arrow at the end of the row and choose Print Coupon.
Each code can belong to only one promotion.

title: Pause, edit, or delete a promotion
text: Use the Active switch to pause a deal. Pausing is safer than deleting because deleted promotions cannot be restored.
steps: Click Sidebar > Promotions.
Turn the Active switch on the row on or off to pause or resume it.
Double-click the row or click the arrow at the end to Edit or Delete.
When two deals affect the same item, the one with the higher Priority number wins.

title: Discount a whole category
text: Create a promotion to discount every item in a category. The discount applies automatically at the register.
steps: Click Sidebar > Promotions.
Click Add Promotion.
Choose Category Discount and set the discount amount.
Select the categories, set the schedule and branches, then click Save.
